items.text: This week I caught up with members of the ND Broadcasters Association while they were in DC. We discussed efforts to continue promoting access to public media, news & of course reliable coverage of ND sports teams. https://t.co/uEyb6FLrVd

Grand Forks chiropractors Dr. Kris Anderson and Dr. Carson Muth were in DC this week—we discussed efforts to reduce burdens on their patients through the Chiropractor Medicare Coverage Modernization Act. https://t.co/Cw7x6JWwPL

The Ocean Shipping Reform Act has now passed both the House and Senate. By holding ocean carriers accountable & prohibiting unreasonable treatment of U.S. shippers, this leg. will help ensure ND exporters have fair and reliable access to foreign markets. https://t.co/dyvKZETBVe

My legislation to streamline and improve energy development permitting was advanced out of @EnergyGOP committee. This is about alleviating the regulatory burden for energy developers & empowering private mineral holders to exercise their property rights. https://t.co/o2RNqDGZaa

Met with members of the McKenzie County Grazing Association this week. We’re working to ensure the USFS maintains fair and equitable treatment for our ranchers & is consulting w/ grazers, taking their input & relying on their expertise for any changes to the rangeland practices. https://t.co/M1psM0aGTi

YMCAs provide important services that contribute to the overall wellness of our communities. This week I caught up with YMCA officials from North Dakota while they were visiting DC. https://t.co/0ELfDeaFlL

Sat down with members of the ND Broadcasters Association while they were in DC for their nationwide annual conference & discussed efforts to cont. promoting access to local community news plus of course coverage of ND sports teams. https://t.co/AIXWW0jelv

Met with members of the North Dakota School Nutrition Association this week. As Ranking Member of the Senate Ag. Appropriations Committee it was beneficial to hear their feedback as we begin the FY24 process. https://t.co/hafkQZRnqi
This week I heard from Ellen & Reba, #NorthDakota reps with the @LungAssociation, about the latest efforts to promote research, treatment & prevention of lung disease. https://t.co/oqfX8KMNKH
Met with North Dakota insurers and talked about several issues, including the need to keep crop insurance strong in the upcoming farm bill. https://t.co/aChnacMN2j
Appreciate ND Insurance Commissioner Jon Godfread updating me on insurance issues in #NorthDakota including health insurance, flood insurance and data privacy. https://t.co/wnNtZAvtfY

With less than 20% of the farm bill directly supporting ag producers, we need to make sure crop insurance, ARC & PLC are effective. Discussed this at our @SenateAgGOP hearing this week with the leaders of the nation’s two largest farm organizations, @FarmBureau + @NFUDC. https://t.co/a8Bi7Z0Cqi

We have great oncologists at the Sanford Roger Maris Cancer Center in #NorthDakota. I met with a few of them this week, who updated me on ways we can improve care for patients & work together on new treatments and one day, a cure. I appreciate the work they do. https://t.co/OOSm2azHbb

Cosponsored a Senate Res. to honor National Nurses Week this week. Nurses provide an important role when it comes to health care & we are grateful for the men and women who work long hours offering care and compassion to patients in need. https://t.co/rm2opge3T3

Honored to be awarded the @PIANational 2023 Legislator of the Year Award. Crop insurance is the number one risk management tool for our farmers, and we have outstanding independent insurance agents who serve our communities well. https://t.co/vm3RauAINc

Met today w/ producers, agribusiness & crop insurance providers in Leeds to gather input on the upcoming farm bill. Discussed efforts to improve and strengthen the farm safety net, incl. crop insurance, ARC & PLC. https://t.co/oHJOtL2tD5

Discussed w/ RMA Administrator & ND producers efforts to strengthen risk management tools for our farmers and ranchers. Crop insurance is the heart of the farm safety net, & we’re working to protect this important program, while giving producers more coverage options. https://t.co/lWxWVzDJIr

Convened a meeting w/ Devils Lake Mayor, ND Health Comm. & leaders from Essentia, Altru & CHI on the future of health care in the Lake Region. Our health care workers do a tremendous job, but we need investment in facilities to attract more staff & better meet local needs. https://t.co/kqcbs3vwWx

Had the pleasure of meeting with Fargo Moorhead West Fargo Chamber of Commerce this week. We discussed several issues important to the Red River Valley, including the farm bill and crop insurance, water issues, workforce challenges, and supporting our military and vets. https://t.co/OwcdqbzJTu
Happy New Year! Mikey and I wish everyone in North Dakota and across the country health and happiness in 2024. https://t.co/VqACTOS8q2

We must uphold our promise to take care of & honor those who have fought to defend our country & way of life. At @NDLegion winter conference, we outlined efforts to improve veterans’ access to health care, and ensure they receive the benefits & recognition they have earned. https://t.co/q7LwixLBbG

It’s always great visiting with @NDGrainGrowers. We discussed important updates to the Farm Bill and making sure North Dakota producers have access to crop insurance so they can continue providing the highest-quality, lowest-cost food supply in the world. https://t.co/GHysSykOgv

Army Chief Warrant Officer Garrett Illerbrunn, a North Dakota native, was injured on Christmas day in an attack on our troops in Iraq. Went to Walter Reed where Garrett is receiving treatment to check on him and visit with his mother. Mikey and I are praying for his recovery. https://t.co/c6Oz4CmWsB

Introduced a bill with @SenatorRounds to help ensure that tribal members receive reimbursements for approved outside health care services in a timely manner. This is all about improving health care and ensuring that @IHSgov upholds its commitment. https://t.co/ofv19BTipK

Had the opportunity to tour the new Heart of America Medical Center in Rugby set to open later this year. I commend the team at HAMC on building a state-of-the-art, lasting facility that will serve current & future generations & I remain committed to similar efforts across ND. https://t.co/wPpZeNmZya
